title: Decision-tree depth of recursive NAND
statement: For every nonnegative integer $d$, define a Boolean function on $2^d$ sign-valued inputs recursively: at depth zero it returns its single input, and each subsequent level applies the two-input NAND function to the outputs on the two recursively defined input blocks. The minimum depth of a deterministic decision tree computing this function is $2^d$.
hypotheses_covered: The function is the recursively defined NAND function on $2^d$ inputs
Decision trees query a finite sign alphabet and compute the function
